name: mazeosaur
description: A single-player mazing tower defense in the WC3 maul tradition. Web plays off servers; iOS and Android play fully offline.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/sim && tsc --noEmit -p packages/content && tsc --noEmit -p packages/game && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p tools
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:readmes && npm run typecheck && npm test
